description: Full Telegram round-trip with the target on Codex CLI driving a local model via --oss --local-provider ollama. Switches topic 2525 to codex-cli, then asserts the agent replies via telegram-reply.sh. Note: this scenario only passes when the target has Ollama installed locally AND topicCodexLocalProvider is configured for topic 2525; otherwise it falls back to Codex's normal cloud path and we lose the local-model assertion. The scenario itself does NOT install Ollama or flip the local-provider config — that's an operator pre-condition documented in docs/local-model-recipe.md.

steps.text: test-driver-probe-PING13: please reply with exactly the token PING13 followed by the model name you are running on. Under 30 words. Do not run any tools.
